name: Death by chocolate Guilt free icecream cone
ingredients_raw: Ice Cream (65%): Milk & Milk Solids (Cream, Skimmed Milk Powder), Maltitol, Fructooligosaccharide, Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Mass, Permitted Emulsifier (471, 433) and Stabilizer (412, 407, 461), Stevia. Topping & Spray (17%): Chocolate Coating (Vegetable Oil, Maltitol, Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Butter, Lecithin), Chocolate (4%). Wafer Biscuit cone (18%): Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Maltitol, Oligofructose, Vegetable Oil, Starch, Lecithin, Sucralose, Salt. Allergen Declaration: Contains milk and wheat. Product produced in plant where soya and nut-based products are also produced. Guilt Free Cones -
